incidentDescription: I was using my 4 month old Revlon 1875 Ionic Ceramic blow dryer this morning and thought I felt the handle getting a little warm. I unplugged it and checked with my husband, who said it was a little warm - but nothing to worry about. I plugged the dryer back in and ran it for a few more minutes until it started burning my hand. I attempted to shut it off but the button would not go down - I had to shove it down with all my might to get the dryer to turn off and pulled it out of the wall. I tried to plug it back in to see if the button was melted down and the button will not budge. Thankfully not nearly as bad as the other incidents on here (fires, blow ups), but still quite frightening. Not sure I'll be purchasing anything other than makeup from this company ever again. :( Given the number of other incident reports, it may be helpful for the manufacturer to discontinue, recall, or solve the problem rather than excusing themselves from the problem. Just because Revlon licenses their name to Helen of Troy does not excuse them - their brand name is still on the product and it's their name/brand being tarnished.

productDescription: Ryobi lithium ion battery and charger
incidentDescription: Battery pack was being charged and exploded shotting shrapnel across the room and into dry wall.  Battery caught fire and caused floor and drywall damage.  Would have burned down house if we were not home with a fire extinguisher.
victimSeverity: Injury, No First Aid or Medical Attention Received

productDescription:
hand held, electric hair curlers

Infinity Pro Conair

(Info found on cord)
AWM E141875
Style 20812
VW-1 20
productType: Hair Curlers, Curling Irons, Clips & Hairpins (1682)
incidentDescription:
On approximately 12/20/13, the consumer sustained burns while using the hand held hair curlers. The curler has settings of 310, 330, 360 & 400 degrees.

The curler had been plugged into the  outlet for approximately 5 minutes and on the 330 degree setting, when the consumer started to use it.  However, the handle and the plastic tip of the curler became extremely hot to the touch.  The curler was so hot that it burned both of the consumer’s hands.  The consumer was holding the curler’s handle with her left hand and she attempted to grab the other tip of the curler with her right thumb and index finger.  The extreme heat caused the consumer to drop the curler and it hit her on the chest.  The consumer sustained a severe burn to her chest, approximately 3-1/2” long.  The curler then bounced on the and gouged the floor (approx.  1” long).  The consumer picked up the curler a few seconds after it fell (approx. 5 - 15 sec.) by holding the power cord.  She placed it in the sink, turned the power off and unplugged it from the outlet.  The consumer discontinued use of the curlers

The consumer applied [REDACTED] to her burns.  The burns on her chest lasted approximately 2 months and she said at one point, the burn opened up and puss came out of it.  

(12/2013)  The consumer called the manufacturer and she was advised to send the curler back to them by mail.

The consumer received a letter back from the mfr. on 12/26/13 and it contained a label to cover the cost of shipping the curler back to them.  

The consumer sent the curler back to the mfr. for testing.

The consumer received a letter 1/15/2014 and it indicated that they had tested the product.  Their engineers found the curler to be operating in the correct range and they did not experience the problem she indicated.  The curler was also returned to the consumer.

The consumer has been in contact with [REDACTED], Mfr’s Claims Administratror.  However, during a subsequent call, the consumer was told by [REDACTED] that she would have to speak with someone else.  The consumer asked [REDACTED] if she was an administrator and the consumer said that she no longer answered that question.

Over, the past months, consumer received 5 letters from the manufacturer relating to this issue.


The consumer contacted WTMJ News Station (Call for Consumer Action), and spoke with [REDACTED] (last name unknown). Tel:  414-967-5495, Milwaukee, WI. [REDACTED] also asked the consumer some questions similar to filing a report.  [REDACTED suggested that the consumer contact the CPSC.  


(4/17/2014)  The consumer received a settlement letter from the manufacturer, releasing them from all claims.  The settlement was for $250.  The consumer has not signed that letter.

The consumer said she has an $850 bathroom floor and the amount of the settlement does not cover the cost of damage to the floor.  The consumer said that she was not sure of the type of flooring in her bathroom.  The consumer believes that the news station contact to the firm may have been a factor in the settlement offer.  Even though the consumer contacted the firm in December 2013, she did not get the settlement letter until 4/17/2014.

The tip of the barrel is hard plastic and the consumer said it was extremely hot and it should not have been


The consumer sent the curler back to the firm twice and they tested it the first time and returned it to her.  The consumer said that when the curler was returned to her, the tag with the watts, volts and other information was no longer there.


*  1112MP5 is written on the curler's metal prong
*  E52826 is written on the electric cord itself
victimSeverity: Injury, First Aid Received by Non-Medical Professional

incidentDescription:

There have been no injuries 

The caller has contacted the manufacture and has been advised to return the heater, however the consumer has decided to report the safety hazards with this heater before doing this.

productDescription:
dehumidifier 30 pt

incidentDescription: (05/10/2014) The consumer stated that she went downstairs to find that her dehumidifier was not working. She checked the circuit breaker and saw that it had flipped. She reset the breaker and turned the dehumidifier back on. Within five seconds, sparks came out of the front of the unit and the circuit breaker tripped again. This happened twice. productDescription: MR COFFEE FRESH TEA ICED TEA MAKER INTERTEK 3081955
manufacturer: Sunbeam Products, Inc. d/b/a  Jarden Consumer Solutions
incidentDescription: PURCHASED NEW MR COFFEE "FRESH TEA" ICED TEA MAKER, INTERTEK 3081955. USED IT ONCE AND UNPLUGGED IT. WHEN PLUGGED BACK IN AT A LATER DATE, AFTER A FEW MINUTES, SCALDING HOT WATER SHOT OUT OF THE MACHINE. WE DIDN'T REALIZE THAT THE ON-OFF BUTTON WAS STUCK IN THE ON POSITION AND WAS STARTED WHEN PLUGGED IN. THE BUTTON REMAINS STUCK IN THE ON POSITION AND THE UNIT CANNOT BE SAFELY USED.

productDescription: Smaller space heater
manufacturer: Sunbeam Products, Inc. d/b/a  Jarden Consumer Solutions
incidentDescription: My heater started to smell, so I unplugged it and moved it from the bathroom to the front room. After a few more minutes I smelled it stronger, went into the front room and flames were coming from it. I carried it to the pool and burned thumb and finger slightly. I soaked it in the pool. And I took 2 pictures of it. I threw it away and told my daughter to throw the one I bought her away as well. Mine was white and hers was red. I got a phone call today saying it's been recalled and could get refunds. I no longer have either heater but I do have 2 pics of mine after it burned. How can I get a refund? I can't send in the cords because we threw them away.
victimSeverity: Injury, No First Aid or Medical Attention Received

productDescription: Lithium-ion battery.
incidentDescription: Battery plugged in to charge 6/9/14 at 8:00 pm. Light on charger should turn from red to green when done. Came back 6/10/14 at 8:00 pm. Light still red, battery VERY hot to the touch. Removed charger from wall, waited 30 minutes for battery to cool enough to be handled. Removed from charger. Battery deformed from heat. Had I not been home, I suspect that this could have resulted in a fire had the battery exploded, and could have caused injury to person or properly. Should be examined for possible recall action.

productDescription: Product is a hand held hair dryer
incidentDescription: This morning I was using my dryer and the coils turned bright red and a flame came out and landed on the carpet. I turned quickly as I was using the dryer in front of the mirror.

productDescription:
Black & Decker Blender
CAT. NO. BL1900
550W 120V-60Hz
Stainless Steel and Black
Glass Blending Jar
incidentDescription:
I have a Black & Decker blender that is approximately 6 to 7 years old. Has been used less than 50 times in its life. I used the blender the morning of 6/13/14 to blend a protein shake. After finished I washed the glass container and put it back on the blender base. I forgot to unplug the unit after I was done. I worked a 48 hour shift at the fire station and returned home on the morning of 6/15/14. No one was in the house during this 48 hour period of time. When returned home I noticed pieces of plastic on the counter. I began to look and noticed that the blender had come on and run until the plastic gears and base on the glass jar had come apart. Not sure if the motor burned up or not but the counter was covered with a black soot. I have no idea how long it ran before this happened but I am for sure it is a fire hazard.

Black & Decker CAT. NO. BL1900
Type 1 550W 120V-60Hz

productDescription: Dualit two-slice electric toaster.
incidentDescription: Two-slide Dualit electric toaster purchased new on Oct. 15, 2013. It has received light use in a one-person household. After less than eight months of use, the mechanical timer sticks and does not run to zero to shut the unit off as it is supposed to. The toaster stays on continuously unless manually shut off. It is a fire hazard.

productDescription: Air Purifiers
incidentDescription:
Caller is contacting the hot line on behalf of his 90 yr old mother who purchased two air purifiers sometime around December 2013 and very quickly began having problems when they were running.
After a very short time her eyes began watering and her throat became very sore.

They turned the air purifiers off and have left them off
They are reporting this incident with this product hoping that someone would see this report and investigate any defects.

There are no actual injuries

The caller has contacted the manufacturer
victimSeverity: Injury, Level of care not known

productDescription: Gas Fire-pit in the center of a stone table-top
incidentDescription: Product is a gas fire-pit, used per manufacturer directions (i.e. placed manufacturer provided lava rocks around burner, along with faux logs.  The heat created by the flames from the burner melted the metal frame used to hold logs.  The manufacturer said they think something fell into the burner area and blocked the flames so the heat transferred into the burner causing the situation, however all visible foreign objects had been cleared prior to initial and all subsequent uses. The burner does not have anything covering it which would prevent something from falling into the burner area, nor is there any indicator that something may be present. This product was manufactured in 2006 and has been working without incident until this situation. I have made numerous attempts to contact the manufacturer and they say since the product is no longer manufactured they are unable to assist and make reference to something potentially falling into the burner area - which it has not, all foreign objects are removed prior to use and has been since purchase/ use... including the most recent uses this year.

productDescription: Revlon Ionic Tourmaline Ceramic Hair Dryer (RV544)
incidentDescription: My wife was using the hair dryer to dry her hair and it started turning off then back on so she stopped using it.  Then the next day, it started sparking and arching where the cord goes into the hair dryer, burning some of the protective covering on the cord.  She was almost burned by this as her hand was not to far away it and it was close to her hair.

productDescription: Hamilton Beach reversbile electric griddle
incidentDescription: Hamilton Beach reversible griddle G43.  Bacon grease does not drain into the grease trap very well.  Instead it collects on the griddle then seeps down between the two reversible griddle plates and has the potential to come in contact with the electric heating elements.  Creating a fire hazard.  I have had several occasions where smoke has come from under the griddle plates but no fire.

productDescription: ColemanCPX™6 Rechargeable Power Cartridge used in a Coleman 4D CPX™ LED Duo Lantern.
incidentDescription:
Anticipating the loss of power from an impending storm, I plugged in the chargeable power supply to an emergency light.
  The light is a 4D CPX™ LED Duo Lantern which uses a CPX™6 Rechargeable Power Cartridge.
  The cartridge was not housed in the lantern during charging.
  After about an hour and a half, I smelled burning plastic and traced the smell back to the charging power cartridge which was already in advanced stages of melting.
  Despite the melting cartridge being too hot to hold, I was able to unplug the power supply.
  I can only imagine that if I had not been home or was asleep, the charging cartridge would have eventually caused a fire.

productDescription: Dehumidifier
incidentDescription:
I called the Gree recall number and they gave me a reference number - [REDACTED].
This particular dehumidifier was very hot and had an electrical burning smell when I turned it off.  It was cracking and popping.  I highly suspect that this model should be recalled as well, since it is the same model and just 2 or 3 months from being part of the recall.  I need to contact the government to report this situation as well.  I do not believe this product was safe to operate.  I have another frigidaire dehumidifier that I have unplugged, that I purchased in 2010.  Unfortunately, I can not trust these products.  

I would like to know why this dehumidifier is not part of the recall, because I suspect it will be once a few more tragic situations occur to life and property. But, I know there is a price tag on everything, including human life.

productDescription: Water chiller and heater that has a 5 gallon water bottle on top.  Purchased at K-Mart by [REDACTED] (renter) and sold only at K-Mart (item #470057264129 SKU 817206011323)
incidentDescription:
Unoccupied (renters out for night) House Fire.  Insurance Investigation revealed that the origin and cause was a Primo water chiller/heater that had been leaking.  Total structure loss.

Previously reported via telephone but too many errors discovered when hard copy received back for signature (Doc# H1 3B0056A) Report # 20131107-558AB-1366872)

House contained three renters, one family in main portion (total loss), one single man in downstairs apartment (water damage only) and one man in garage apartment (smoke damage only)

productDescription: Crock Pot Brand crock pot
manufacturer: Sunbeam Products, Inc. d/b/a  Jarden Consumer Solutions
incidentDescription: I started a roast in my Crock Pot brand crock pot around 9:30. At 1:30 I heard a loud pop and found the lid had shattered, glass flew up and all over the counter and into the food and even shot small pieces on my arm resulting in a few small cuts.
victimSeverity: Injury, Level of care not known

productDescription: Gree SoleusAir 70 pint dehumidifier
manufacturer: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai
incidentDescription:
I have a Gree SoleusAir 70 pint dehumidifier. The unit has been in use in my basement. It overheated and filled my basement with smoke and electrical "hot" smell. I identified that it was coming from the dehumidifier and unplugged the unit before there was any significant damage to my home. 

I checked and there is a recall, but my specific number is not on the list. I phoned the company and they were unable to assist me because it was not included at this time. 

I believe that it should be included given the large number of problems with the units manufactured during the same time as mine. 

I am looking for help to get it added. I was very lucky that I was home at the time of the incident or I may not have been so lucky. I also have a 4 year old in my home and can not allow myself to think of how terrible it could have been if there had been a fire. 

Thank you for your help.

productDescription: Emeril T-fal pressure cooker
incidentDescription:
An Emeril T-fal pressure cooker was being used to cook soup.  After a loud bang it spewed the contents of the spot out and up.  Soup was on the ceiling which is 15 feet + high.
The person making the soup narrowly escaped injury.  He received hot soup on his face and hands but removed it immediately.  He does not appear to be injured.
It appears that the pressure release valve waited far too long to function and relieve the growing pressure inside the cooker.

productDescription: Hair dryer black Babyliss PRO Ceramix Xtreme model BAB2000
incidentDescription:
I have a Babyliss PRO Ceramix Xtreme model BAB2000 hair dryer purchased from Amazon in October 2013.  Since I first used this product, I noticed that the handle got hotter than any hair dryer I had previously owned.  I used it still, until two days ago when it twice flipped the breaker in  my house when I was using it.  I tried it again the next day and this time sparks flew out of the handle!!!  At least I had enough wits about me to hold on to the hair dryer with one hand and unplug it from the wall with the other.  Had I dropped it, as was my first instinct, my house could have burned down!

Contacted Amazon, but they won't issue a refund at this point.  Contacted Conair, who make this product, and they will only replace it with an identical product (which I am scared to use.)  

This is a dangerous product and very poor customer service to go along with it!

productDescription: Bodum® rose gold glass coffee press.  Sold at Starbucks.  A glass liner (looks like a beaker) with a metal frame that is gold colored and has a plastic bottom.
model: Bodum® rose gold glass coffee press.
incidentDescription: This product was purchased at Starbucks in Nov 2013.  On Tuesday, [REDACT], I was using it in the morning to make my coffee at my desk (home office).  I had just filled the press with boiling water when i moved to pour into my coffee cup, across my desk.  It was full.  As i began to pour, the plastic bottom fell off and the glass sleeve (like a beaker) slid out.  The glass beaker fell to my desk, hit the corner and tumbled into my office chair.  My chair is all leather (looks more like a piece of living room furniture) and the contents of the beaker immediately poured into the seat, the one i was sitting on.  I jumped up as quickly as possible, but i was burned badly on my backside.  I jumped into a cold shower (my skin was actually "steaming") to cool down and sat on ice packs for a couple hours before going to the doctor.  The diagnosis was first and second degree burns to my backside (butt and lower back).  I received a prescription for burn cream and pain medication to ease the discomfort.  It not quite a week, but the burn area remains extremely uncomfortable.

productDescription:
Farberware FW Family Size Electric Griddle Model Number G767
UPC 6922495798900
incidentDescription: I purchased the Farberware Family Size Griddle Model Number G767 yesterday at my local Walmart. The box has a picture of the griddle being placed in  the lower rack of a dishwasher and states it is dishwasher safe. As this is electric, I had my doubts and read the brochure thoroughly. It states not to submerge the griddle in liquid and says the warming tray and drip tray are dishwasher safe. This is very deceiving to the consumer who is. Easily led to believe the griddle is somewhat like the George Foreman and dishwasher safe given the photo on the box and accompanying statement to that effect. If placed in the dishwasher or submerged in water and then plugged in, this could be dangerous

productDescription: Purchased two gas grills from Viking for outdoor use built in. Model VGBQ5304RE2NSS serial number 060211c00022196 and the identical model serial number 061411c00024098.
productType: Gas or Lp Grills or Stoves (For Outdoor Use) (3248)
incidentDescription:
Purchased two gas grills from Viking for outdoor use built in. Model VGBQ5304RE2NSS serial number 060211c00022196 and the identical model serial number 061411c00024098.
One unit was generally unused since October 2012 installation. The first unit was a problem since installation and a certified Viking service provided initial service after installation in October 2012. Neither unit was used until May 2013 and did not operate well from the beginning. The same Viking repair people came initially in October 2012 and again after non use in the winter in May 2013. The clicking devise did not stop clicking after initial effort to activate grill. Technician replaced the spark modules and the igniters in May but the clicking continued. The unit was used on weekends only from June thru early September. House is vacation weekend summer house.
When the used unit was used on Memorial Day weekend in 2014, the result was worrisome. The unit was ignited but the clicking never stopped and there was a fire. The knob was damaged and the unit could not be turned off except by pulling the plug. Since there is another unit on the property although almost never used, we tried to use it and found the same problem with the clicking. Turned off the unit and tried it again to find the clicking stopped at this point. It would seem that the unit or the parts are defective and should be replaced. I called Viking who noted that their 1 year warranty on parts and labor expired. I spoke to the consumer complaint department, noted the fire hazard but was denied access to the supervisor and was told that the supervisor agreed they would do nothing to address this problem. I asked to speak to a technical person but was informed they had no one who could speak to consumers. This product is dangerous and should be replaced with a working grill. It is not fit for its use.

productDescription: A SoleusAir 30 pint dehumidifier, Serial No  6500000926, Model SG-DEH-30M-1A
manufacturer: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai
incidentDescription:
We purchased at Menards in Cedar Rapids, IA a SoleusAir by Gree Dehumidifier on April 14, 2011, Model SG-DEH-30m-1A, Serial No. 65100000926, MD000021511000.  A few days ago, I noticed no water running out of the hose.  Checked the case and it was extremely hot.  The compressor was overheating. We unplugged it.   Fortunately, we caught it before it caught on fire.
  Since this was recalled, shouldn't we get a refund on it?
We received no recall notice on this.  A friend informed me of this web site as he also had trouble with his dehumidifier, thus I found out that our unit is under the recall notice. Is there any way of getting a refund on this?  
Since we now need to get another dehumidifier, how do we determine what kind and brand to purchase.  Is there any dehumidifier that is safe to have?  I understand that most of the parts are manufactured in China.  Is this correct?

productDescription: 3 burner gas/butane barbecue kept immaculately clean..
productType: Gas or Lp Grills or Stoves (For Outdoor Use) (3248)
brand: Fiesta Optima series barbecue/ PRO SERIES XL
incidentDescription:
My mother, [REDACTED] lifted the lid to her Fiesta barbecue, turned on the full tank of butane, pushed the start button, turned on 2 burners..a noise came from the barbecue, it had 2 explosions and a ball of fire..She was not standing over it, just a few feet away..within moments the fire ran up the patio up the wall and in to the vent and blew off her roof and the neighbors roof and burned several rooms at her the townhouse she is renting. She was rushed to the hospital for smoke inhalation.
Their are multiple recalls on another model of the Fiesta barbecue from the same manufacturer.

productDescription: Product is standard dehumidifier.  Using hose for continuous operation.
manufacturer: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai
incidentDescription: Dehumidifier was in regular use in the basement, set at a humidity level and allowed to turn on and regulate as needed.  Last month I smelled a burning plastic/rubber smell and traced it to the dehumidifier which was smoking slightly and smelling badly.  It was unplugged, and I looked for recall or safety information.

productDescription:
Soleus Air by Gree
Model GL-DEH-50-2l2
SERIAL # 10014050469
Date Range is 1211
manufacturer: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai
incidentDescription:
The dehumidifier that we have has been freezing over in the back next to the air filter.  We would cut off the unit and defrost and restart, but it still continues.  We have the filter clean.  We have defrosted the unit a total of 4 times.  We have checked on the internet and found the unit that we have has been recalled.  The unit will have ice accumulations on the filter in the rear about 3-4 inches thick.  The unit continues to run without stopping.  The unit is now unplugged and removed from service.

We have a Soleus Air by Gree.  Model number is GL-DEH-50-2.  SERIAL # is 10014050469
Date Range is 1211.

productDescription: Model 259NP  infiniti Pro Conair 1875 Watt Styling tool.  Color is orange
incidentDescription:
My spouse has been using the hair dryer on a daily basis. The other day, the Unit Sparked, sending sparks to her arm.  Luckily she was not burnt or hurt.

I noticed the power cord at the end of the hair dryer's hang up plastic clip is frayed and cut in half.
This has happened with several other hair dryers and I believe that the Safety Products Group should look into this matter and investigate.  It is not just a single manufacturers issue. 
Please see pictures of the [REDACTED]unit from June 2012.

productDescription: Toaster Oven
productType: Electric Counter-top Ovens, Broilers or Toaster Ovens (216)
incidentDescription: Toasted waffle in toaster oven; left the kitchen for a few minutes and when went back into kitchen the toaster oven was smoking and was on fire.

productDescription: Courant 1.7 Liter Stainless Steel Cordless Electric Kettle
manufacturer: Luzerne Trading Company, Inc dba Impecca USA
incidentDescription:
I purchased a Courant 1.7 Liter Stainless Steel Cordless Electric Kettle. I've used electric kettles in the past and noticed this one behaves differently with the auto shutoff feature. There are two flaws with the design: 

1. when the kettle it removed from the base while it is still heating it does not trip the auto shutoff. If you then empty the kettle and put it back on the base it is still turned on. 

2. The boil dry auto shutoff does not seem to work correctly. It turns the unit off with a click but the switch seems to be in the middle (ie not completely off) and seems to cycle between off and back on again. The result is the kettle gets hot, though not hot enough to cause a fire.

productDescription: Revlon 1875W Turbo/Lightweight Hair Dryer
incidentDescription: While using the Revlon 1875 this morning to dry my hair, the dryer sounded like it switched from high to low.  When I shut it off and tried to turn it on again, it still had the low sound and began sparking.  I have only had this dryer for 6 weeks.

productDescription: got notice of the recall for this item. when I removed it from service noticed black scorch marks around the produce. Thank God I got it out of there in time or I probably would of had a fire. Scary, scary, scary!!!!
manufacturer: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. of Zhuhai
incidentDescription:
I just received a notice from Amazon that the dehumidifier I purchased is being recalled. Fortunately I haven't experienced a fire, YET, but when I pulled it out of service noticed black scorched marks around the item.  All I can say is WOW, how lucky am I!!

Why is crappy stuff from China making it into this country. We have had dry wall, now dehumidifiers plus other stuff.

productDescription: Gas Grill
productType: Gas or Lp Grills or Stoves (For Outdoor Use) (3248)
incidentDescription:
The consumer stated that he lit the gas grill and put the food on it. The consumer closed the lid.

The consumer stated that all three thermometers were working normally. The consumer stated that the grill was set on low, 400 F. 

The consumer stated that after 3-4 minutes after closing the lid, the grill blew up. The consumer stated that the house shook.

The consumer stated that there are 3 plates inside the grill. The consumer stated that the plates were blown out. The consumer stated the plates were held in place but the food blew up. The consumer stated that the lid blew open and he saw a flash. 

The consumer stated that he was standing 3ft away from the grill.

The consumer’s facial hairs were burned. The consumer stated that one of the thermometers blew at him on his stomach. The consumer has a bruise on his stomach from the thermometer. 

The consumer stated that he did not receive any medical attention.

The consumer stated that he contacted the retailer. The retailer asked him to bring in the grill to the store for a full refund. The consumer had purchased a grill that was set-up and put together in store (floor model). 

The consumer has not contacted the manf but intends to do so.

This was the third time the consumer was using the grill after purchase.

The consumer reported no unusual gas smell or smoke. 

There are no recalls on this model. 

Correction.  The consumer does not still have the product.  He took it back to Walmart for a refund.  The consumer still has nitemares about it.
victimSeverity: Injury, No First Aid or Medical Attention Received

productDescription: Gas Grill
productType: Gas or Lp Grills or Stoves (For Outdoor Use) (3248)
incidentDescription:
Consumer stated that while using the gas grill for approximately 5 mins the wind blew the flames into the grease tray causing high flames to erupt through the side of the grill.  This incident occurred twice.  He was able to contain the flames with baking soda.  The grill has a design flaw in that it is missing panel which causes wind to blow in the rear of the unit where the flames are located blowing out the flames on the burners at times or pushing the flames into the grease pan.

3/28/14  He spoke with the warranty department and informed them of the incident, he was referred to service department and he was informed that there was no recalls and that it was not a warranty issue, he could contact the retailer to return the unit.

4/2/14 He went to the retailer and spoke to the Mgr and he was advised that he would not take back the grill but would give him a different model grill - that would cost more.  He was shown the other grill and he noticed that it had a fixed to the problem he was having with his grill.  He advised the retailer he would rather have his grill fixed as the grill he was shown than purchase at additional cost a new one.  He contacted the customer care number and was informed that someone would be sent out at no charge.

4/10/14 A service technician came out and agreed that the problem he was having was an issue he contacted his manager to get approval to put a plate on the grill.  He was advised by his manger that under no circumstances should he modify the grill because it would become a liability issue.  He inquired of technician if he would request from his manager to order a firebox for the grill\.  He was advised that he could not make the order because he did not know if the firebox would have the fix on it.

4/14/14 He contacted the retailer and he is not willing to take the grill back.

Caller stated that in his opinion any Sears grill using firebox part number 40900015 that does not include the wind card modification can catch on fire due to flames being pushed into the grease tray.

Caller feels that the grill is a fire hazard.

My fear is that this old firebox style already has post on your site, and that nothing has been done since no one has been injured or killed to date. Only property damage. Another [REDACTED] or [REDACTED]??

I was told by one of the sales associates that they were made for Sears by [REDACTED]. You will have to confirm this.

Model Purchased (older firebox) does not have a shield to block wind from blowing flame out-or-more importantly "down" onto the grease tray that caused it to catch fire!! 

Current models (new firebox) has a "wind shield" attached that prevents this issue. So, someone (grill manufacturers) knows that this issue exists on older models but is refusing to admit it - or fix it!!

incidentDescription: Purchased Calphalon Coffee Maker Model HE121CMG at Bed Bath and Beyond October 2013 and on May 19, 2014 I heard an odd rattling noise coming from kitchen. I quickly unplugged the coffee maker from the electrical outlet.  Smoke continued to emit from the maker and it was so hot that I needed a pot holder to lift it. productDescription: Compact Oven/ Breville Compact Smart Oven model BOV650XL
productType: Electric Counter-top Ovens, Broilers or Toaster Ovens (216)
incidentDescription:
I purchased a Breville Compact Smart Oven model BOV650XL approximately 2 years ago at a local Bed Bath and Beyond.    
Recently the upper heating elements stopped working.  I searched the internet and found reading Amazon reviews other owners reported their ovens also had heating element issues.  Some people fixed the problem by ordering new elements and replacing them.  Being a handy person I ordered new top elements.  When they arrived I took my oven apart.  I found a spade (for the top element) that should be soldered into the PCB was completely loose and it fell out.  The area around the circuit board was burnt from excess heat. I documented it with photos which I have included.  This is a manufacturing defect and quite possibly could have caused a fire in my home.    
I contacted Breville customer service USA in Torrance CA.  I was admonished for opening up the oven and told the unit is out of warranty.  They offered to give me 40% off the purchase of a new unit.  I told them I wasn't interested in buying another Breville appliance.

productDescription: 9 volt battery
incidentDescription:
A 9 Volt battery exploded, which was mounted inside a smoke detector.

I heard what sounded like a gunshot or small explosion, immediately followed by the smoke detector sounding.  The smoke detector stopped sounding after 10 minutes or so (hard wired with battery backup), but then started the beeping associated with a low battery.  Upon opening the battery compartment of the smoke detector, I immediately noticed the battery had burst open.

The battery had burst with such force that it damaged the housing of the smoke detector.  Both the top and bottom of the 9 volt battery had ripped open along with battery acid oozing out.  

Had this battery been located next to someone's ears when it burst (i.e. headphones, etc).  I'm certain that it would have caused hearing damage.

productDescription: Cuisinart Toaster Oven/Broiler. Model TOB-40.  Serial Number 30802.
productType: Electric Counter-top Ovens, Broilers or Toaster Ovens (216)
incidentDescription:
I purchased a Cuisinart Toaster/Broiler Oven. Model TOB-40, Serial Number 30802.  It was purchased online from Amazon.com though it was provided to them directly from Cuisinart.  Purchased 12/7/2013, arrived 12/9/2013.  Worked as described until 5/9/2014.  While cooking a pizza, both within the pizza maker company recommendations and within the usage recommendations provided by Cuisinart, the the glass on the front "door" of the oven shattered when I opened it.  The entire door failed - handle came off, and the left side of the door came off too!  Glass shattered to a distance of greater than one meter from the toaster oven.  I have a few pictures, taken with my mobile phone, showing the damage. 

I was using the oven in bake mode at 400 degrees.  Well within the recommended design use.

After a call to Cuisinart's Customer Service, they are replacing the oven.  However, I am concerned this may be a design problem.  I have owned two other toaster oven/broilers, and neither had this type of failure.  Both just finally stopped working.  

I just recommended by great aunt, who is in her mid-80s, to purchase one and she did.  I am worried that this could happen to her.  If it did, she could be injured as she would have a hard time cleaning up all the of tiny pieces of glass.  I've had to clean my kitchen with a damp cloth - including the floor on my hands and knees - to make sure every small piece of glass is thrown away.  I  have had to throw away all of the cat food on the floor, and also throw out all of the water for my cat.  She may not be able to get down to do that, instead having to wait for her homemaker to help do that days later.

I just want to make sure this isn't a problem with the oven itself and not an isolated incident.

Thank you.

incidentDescription:
HAAN Steam Cleaning Floor Sanitizer Model FS-20+

This is a product that the user fills with water, it creates steam, and it gets pushed along the floor via a long handle similar to a vacuum cleaner.

The product was purchased in 2010 and used once a month.  Now when the unit is filled with water and plugged into a ground fault interrupter equipped outlet, the GFI is triggered.  It does NOT shut down a conventional breaker.  

The unit is out of warranty and the company stated it did not have any other complaints of this issue.  Upon internal inspection it was discovered that water was leaking from the steam chamber into the area of electrical wiring and circuit board.  The wiring and connectors were wet.  Since this was only discovered while using a GFI equipped outlet someone using a regular outlet will be unaware of the hazard.

productDescription: Kenmore refrigerator Model # 795.78409.800; Serial# 804MRNE10879. Exterior is black, has double door refigerator on top with slide out freezer draw on bottom. On the front right door is the ice/water dispenser, with ice maker built into the door.
incidentDescription: I have a Kenmore refrigerator Model # 795.78409.800 . The refrigerator was purchased brand new from Sears a few years ago. After one week of owning this refrigerator my mother went to get ice from the dispenser. She dispensed the ice and filled her cup with water. After taking a drink she noticed a silver screw in her cup. It was determined by me the screw came from the inner ice bucket/dispenser. We contacted sears who sent out a service man as the Refrigerator was brand new and under warranty. The service man came out when my elderly parents were home, said the ice maker is working fine, and he didn't know what they wanted him to do. Upset with the service visit, I ordered a new ice bucket/dispensers through sears parts online and replaced it myself. The new ice bucket/ dispenser has lasted a few years, but on this evening after drinking from the container I heard something rattling. Looking further I observed a silver screw in the bottom of the container. this screw is identical to the other screws in the ice bucket/ dispenser and has white plastic still wrapped in the threads. There is an observable hole were the screw should be located on the ice bucket/ dispenser. I believe this designed is flawed and puts the consumer at risk of injury. I believe the mechanical ice dispenser when activated puts increased pressure on the walls of the ice bucket causing the screw to pop. Gravity allows the screw to fall through with the ice and into a cup. I often eat the ice and it is by luck I did not ingest or sustained injury due to the screw falling into my cup.

productDescription: Kingsford grill cleaning brush with stainless steel wires
productType: Manual Cleaning Equipment (Excl. Buckets and Pails) (480)
incidentDescription: My husband cleaned our grill with a Kingsford grill brush with stainless steel wires. I felt a sharp pain in my throat upon eating a piece of chicken, which did not resolve after several hours and many attempts to dislodge whatever was bothering me. I finally went to the ER where an x-ray was taken. A stainless steel wire from the grill brush (over 1/2 in long) was lodged in the soft tissue of my throat. I had to go into the OR and be put under general anaesthesia to have the foreign body removed immediately. From what the doctor said, they have seen this before and sometimes with much worse results such as a perforated bowel. I consider myself lucky that it happened to me and not to either of my young children and that I did not swallow the wire completely, potentially injuring me worse.

productDescription: Kenmore grill model 148.23683310
productType: Gas or Lp Grills or Stoves (For Outdoor Use) (3248)
incidentDescription:
Our new kenmore grill was on our deck. On a windy day the grill was blown 6-7 feet from its usual location and came into rest against a deck table chair. Incredibly, the side burner's control know was turned and depressed by the chair igniting the side burner. The side burners cover lid was down and the grill cover was still on grill. The side burner got so hot it scorched the covers lid and burned/melted the grill cover. Luckily smoke was observed by my wife and I was able to turn off the side burner before any further incident. 

This incident could have been prevented. The grill features and one-turn and press ignition. Since the main lp valve was left on it took very little effort to depress and turn control knob turning on the side burner. Also, the grill features 3 locking wheels. Only one of 3 were locked. All three should be locked to prevent wandering grills.

incidentDescription:
We have had our Summer Baby Monitor (BestView Choice #28460) for about a year.  One week ago we picked up the monitor in the middle of the night and it was extremely hot (normally not hot at all), it was so hot I got nervous having it in the house and took it outside until it cooled off.  When we tried to turn the monitor back on the low battery light was red and then it shut off after 2 seconds.  We tried to plug it into the AC charger and it still wouldn't work.
We ended up ordering a new charger from summerinfant.com waited a few days for that to come and when we got that charger, the monitor still wouldn't hold a charge.  We then went to the local battery store to test a new battery with the monitor and charger.  
We have come to the conclusion that the battery over heated so much that it may have fried some circuits in the monitor unit itself, as now the monitor wont hold a charge with any battery nor will it work when plugged into the AC charger.

I determined that the smell was coming from the dehumidifier, so I turned it off and unplugged the unit.  I removed the drawer, which felt warm, and the round housing inside was hot to the touch.  The smell was coming out of the top of the unit where the air is blown out by the internal fan.

productType: Electric Counter-top Ovens, Broilers or Toaster Ovens (216)
incidentDescription: We had received a new Black & Decker countertop oven/broiler (model CTO8500) as a Christmas gift a few years ago. Having no need for it at that time, we put it in storage. Yesterday our toaster stopped working and instead of buying a new one, we decided to get this toaster oven out of storage. We inboxed it cleaned it with a damp soft cloth and placed it on the counter. I left the door open and the unit unplugged to insure it was fully dry prior to operating it. After about a half hour, I closed its door and plugged it in. I set the time on the unit and decided to turn it on to make sure all was functional for tomorrow morning breakfast. After being on for about 30 seconds, I heard a loud "pop" followed by smoke. I quickly disconnected the unit from power and ventilated the kitchen. On 04-14-2014, wife was using the steam mop and all of a sudden the mop quit working.  The body portion of the mop unit became very hot and stopped working.  I allowed it to cool down before inspecting the unit.  I found cracks on the plastic of the body unit amd some warping. I called customer service on 03-18-2014 regarding a solution t the problem. I asked them if there were any recalls on the unit that were caused from the overheating.  They answer "No".  I suggested to them that the unit nees to tbe redesigned or install a type of insulation in the plastic portion of the body including the water tank as to prvent cracking and electrical malfunction.

incidentDescription:
The consumer stated that this was bought by son-in-law.

On 03/09/14, the consumer's wife was cleaning the pan. The consumer's wife was injured while picking up the pan inset.
The consumer's wife was taken to the hospital for injuries to her left hand pinky finger. At the hospital's ER, the consumer's wife's finger was treated for laceration to the artery. The consumer's wife is on medication for blood thinner. Her finger was stitched up which caused it swell and turn purple. The consumer's wife was opened up again and further examined to find a slit artery. Her artery was stitched up to stop initial bleeding.

On 03/11/14, the consumer's wife went to the specialist for a surgery. Her finger's artery, nerves and 2 tendons were reconnected. 

The consumer stated that the pan insert in the electric roast is very sharp and has a straight edge. The consumer stated that it should be rolled or have a smooth edge.
The consumer stated that they have two of these and they both have sharp, straight edges. 
The consumer stated that he called company's # on the manual (1-866-369-4170 ). The consumer stated that the number is for a sweepstakes offer.

productDescription: Revlon 1875 Ionic Ceramic hair dryer, color black, snowflake cold shot button, Helen of Troy, Made in China.
incidentDescription: I have a Revlon 1875 ionic ceramic hair dryer and today, while I was trying to dry my hair, it short circuited. First it shut itself off. I thought this was odd.  I doubled checked the settings on the dryer and it was still on high/hot. So I pressed the reset button on the wall switch and also the reset on the dryer. The dryer started again and then stopped. So I pressed all the resets again and then the cord sparked at the point where it meets at the base of the dryer. It singed my left wrist. And I see a hole in the cord and I can see exposed wires.  I think I would have had a fire if it wasn't for the wall switch which shut off the electricity.  This is the only time I had any problems with this dryer.  I can say that I was happy with the dryer up to this point.  I goggled Revlon and I read that they are notorious for ignoring similar complaints.  I am now weary of all Revlon products.  I do not plan to buy any Revlon again.

incidentDescription: We have used the Safety 1st Humidifier in my son's room pretty consistently for the first six months after he was born in August of 2011.  We then had central humidification installed on our furnace and the unit was cleaned and stored for several months.  We took it to our cottage that we use on weekends, and began using it for a few weekends a month when we visited our cottage.  The unit was emptied, cleaned, and unplugged when not in use.  This weekend the unit ran out of water, but instead of the automatic shut-off engaging, when we were putting our son to bed, we could smell burning.  We didn't realize it was the humidifier, and we filled the water reservoir, which then emptied out through the hole that had melted in the bottom of this unit, all over our raw pine floors.  We quickly unplugged the unit and attempted to clean up the water.  We discovered the plastic had melted through the unit both visibly evident on the top and the bottom of the base. productDescription: 1875 W Salon Performance AC Motor tool Hair Dryer
incidentDescription:
02/06/14- The consumer stated that his wife plugged her hair dryer in then turned the blower to high setting.
The plastic housing of the blower exploded with the two pieces that compose the housing separating and shattering.
Pieces from the blower housing were scattered up to 6 feet from the origin. 
The consumer’s wife was hit by pieces in her cheeks and chest, but no injury was made.

02/04/14- The consumer contacted the manufacturer. 
He initially spoke with a customer service representative who offered a replacement if he returned the item.
After the caller informed the representative of the incident details, this representative transferred the consumer to a recall department representative. 
The recall department representative informed the consumer that his product is not affected by a recall, took a safety complaint and advised the consumer that he will be contacted by the firm’s corporate offices within the next 3 days.

2/6/14- The consumer contacted CPSC because he thinks this product poses a safety hazard to the consumers.

This product is not covered by a recall.

productDescription: Space Heater
incidentDescription:
Compact Fan Heater caught fire purchased from one of the dollar chain stores in January 2014.
The heater had been running earlier but caller had turned it off before going to bed the night before.
The caller had been out of the house approximately two hours.

He returned to his home to find that the heater was on fire as if it had just burst into flames or exploded.
The fire itself appears to have been located at the heater, floor and paneling but there are pieces of plastic stuck to a door, the floor etc.
His sink is porcelain and is now cracked where it wasn't when he left.

There are no injuries to be reported 
The caller has not contacted the manufacturer but does intends to contact them.

productDescription: Dehumidifer model 580.54351500, Serial No. 51E00968QA31-68913

The water bucket was partially full, and the motor was too hot too touch.  I've retried it a couple of times, and it is shot.  Serial number 51E00968QA31-68913.

productDescription: Lasko Fan - Model # 4733 - Manufactured 2003-04
incidentDescription: Lasko Box Fan Model Number 4733 manufactured 2003-04. Had a product recall that I was unaware of. When I went to the turn the fan on I was severely shocked due to what I think was melted wires at the on/off speed setting switch. I contacted Lasko and they were only willing to send a plug but the plug will not fix the problem. They also didn't offer a replacement or any solution. I feel I should be compensated so I may contact my lawyer. I operated the fan under normal operating conditions and there is no warning when I bought the fan that that might happen due to age. If that's the case then these products need to have a warning that they shouldn't be used past a certain amount of hours of use.

incidentDescription: With switch in 'Off' position, motor operates/energizes intermittently.  Machine can seem to be off, but hours later, motor will be pulsing intermittently. productDescription: CBD Li-Ion Replacement battery, black plastic, 8" X 2 1/2 " X 3/4"
incidentDescription:
Battery Report

I was using my ACER Laptop Computer (Aspire 5740/5340 series, model MS2286), utilizing the laptop internal battery. After a a couple of hours, i turned off the computer and plugged it into the charger. After about 3 minutes, we smelled and saw smoke coming from the laptop. I unplugged the laptop from the charger, but the smoke continued to get worse and i could see the battery case starting to melt. I got the battery out, by this time there were two holes about 1 X 1/2 inches, one on top, and one on the bottom of the battery. I could still see fire inside the battery and had to put out the fire in the sink with water. The battery was a lose. The computer battery had a charted hole in the battery compartment. I replaced the battery and reconnected the charger, no smoke and the computer came on. The computer will have to be checked out and repaired as necessary. This narrowed the problem to the Li-Ion battery. I purchased the CBD replacement battery for the ACER factory battery (AS07A41) on Amazon from the vendor Moon Gazer back on Sept 24, 2013. I was lucky that I was home or we could have suffered major damage to our home, also after a little research i found out that the battery could have exploded in my hands. I reported the incident to Amazon and Moon Gazer, which resulted in only a refund of my purchase price of the battery. I was trying to communicated that they were selling a dangerous product to their customers that could cause injuries and property damage.

productDescription: electric room heater
incidentDescription:
(02/07/2014) The consumer stated that the heater self- ignited. 

The consumer stated that he had picked up the girls from school.  The heater had been on about 45 minutes. Then the smoke detector went off. The Three Season’s room was filled with flames and smoke. The consumer took the girls outside to make sure that they were safe. He went back inside, got the fire extinguisher and a flashlight. He turned off the main electrical breaker and then he put out the fire.  

The consumer stated that he discovered that the heater had melted down into itself. The consumer examined the cord that was connected from the heater to the plug in the wall. There was no damage. He picked up the heater with a shovel and took it outside.  

The consumer thinks that the heater caused the fire.
 
The consumer stated that the entire house has smoke and soot damage.

(02/17/2014) The consumer returned the heater to Home Depot. He was advised that he could place a claim with his homeowners insurance. The consumer told them that he would take that under consideration.
(02/17/2014) The consumer received a call from Vornado. He spoke with [REDACTED]. He was advised that they would get the heater from Home Depot to do an examination. After the examination was completed they would discuss paying for damages. The company also asked for the consumer’s permission to send a forensic fire investigator to inspect his home and his electric system. The consumer consented.

(03/10/2014) [REDACTED] from Robson Forensic came out.  He examined everything. He advised the consumer that he saw nothing in the home or the electrical that contributed to the fire. 

Periodically the consumer stated that he spoke with [REDACTED] at Vornado by email. He wanted to know the results of the investigation. He wanted to know if the company was pulling the product off of the shelves. The consumer did not get a response.

(03/18/2014) The consumer received an email for [REDACTED] advising him to file a homeowner’s claim. The consumer stated that there was no reference to the investigation.

productDescription: Nine cup exact slice food processor, item number K40147
incidentDescription:
March 4, 2014

QVC
Customer Service
1200 Wilson Drive at Studio Park
West Chester, PA 19380

KitchenAid
Customer eXperience Center
P.O. Box 218
St. Joseph, M149085

To whom it may concern:

On or about January 16, 2014, I purchased, through QVC, a KitchenAid nine cup exact slice food
processor, item number K40147. I received delivery of the food processor on January 22, 2014. That
evening, while removing the food processor from its packing materials, I attempted to remove a piece of
clear plastic sealing tape which was affixed to a [REDACTED] insert and the user's manual. While removing
the tape, one of the blades located within the [REDACTED] insert fell out of the insert, slicing my right
hand. I required immediate emergency care at the local hospital where I received five stitches to close
the laceration. The ER physician recommended that I see an orthopedic surgeon due to the severity of
the laceration.

On January 24, 2014 I met with the surgeon who concluded I likely injured a nerve or a tendon in the
hand. He recommended surgery.

On February 24, 2014, I had the surgery performed. Regrettably, the laceration severed three nerves in
my hand. I currently require a brace on my hand. After the stitches are removed, I will commence
physical therapy, hopefully to regain functionality in my dominant hand. I have been advised that I will
need the brace for at least four to six weeks. Presently, I am unable to write, button my shirts, tie my
shoes, zip pants and jackets or perform any every-day tasks with my right hand. I have incurred medical
bills and will continue to do so.

I am writing to you for two reasons: first, to advise you of what is a defect in the packaging of the food
processor. I realized after the fact that two of the food processor blades were placed within round holes
which were cut out of the [REDACTED] insert. Each blade was seated in a clear plastic round cup. Neither
blade was secured properly; nor did the two blades include any protective covering . Please accept this
letter as notice of the defect described herein.

{!00940199.DOC; v.}

Please refer this letter to your risk manager or the equivalent and have that individual contact me directly. At a minimum, I would expect you to pay the medical bills relating to treatment received for injuries sustained in this most unfortunate incident.

I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Very truly yours,
[REDACTED]

cc: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission

productDescription: Kenmore Vacuum Cleaner Model 116.21614014
incidentDescription:
We purchased a new Kenmore model 116.21614014 vacuum cleaner in December, 2013 from the Sears store at Casa Grande, AZ.  It was not used until the first part of January, 2014 and we found that the unit would not operate on a household 15 ampere GFIC circuit which is required in all bedroom outlets in Arizona.  The unit is labeled as a 12 ampere unit.

The unit would operate on a standard 20 ampere circuit, but the power head light would dim and the plug-in cord would get hot to the touch.  I returned the unit to the Sears store and they sent it in for repair.  After three weeks the repair department returned it to the store with a note that the unit was operational and nothing was wrong with it.  We took the unit home and tried it again and the results were the same as prior to sending in for repair.  We contacted the Sears store again and they said they would replace the unit.  We returned the unit, picked up the new unit and it did the same thing.

I feel there is an electrical design problem with this model which could lead to a home fire and loss of life.  I felt it was necessary to file a report on this unit.  Please find attached below a note that I sent to the repair facility that checked the unit out.

> I am e-mailing this message to clarify the problem with the Kenmore vacuum cleaner (Model 116.21614014, S/N MC4616416) sent to you for warranty repair. This unit was ordered from the Sears store (#3823) at Casa Grande, AZ on 11/29/2013 and picked up from the store on 12/11/2013. I purchased this unit for my sister and brother-in-law who had just purchased a home across the street from ours. We have a Sears unit like this and had been very happy with it. The first usage of this vacuum was about the middle of January because that is when they arrived in AZ for the winter months.
>
> My sister called me after she started to use the unit and said it had quit working after about 10 minutes. I went over and discovered that the circuit breaker had tripped. I reset the breaker and the vacuum worked again. Later she called me again and said it had quit working again in the second bedroom. The first time it quit was in the master bedroom. Both of these bedrooms have 15 amp GFIC breakers on all wall outlets. I reset the other breaker and turned the vacuum on. The hose and powered head were attached. It seemed to work ok, but I did notice that the light on the power head would dim every now and then. I told my sister I would call an electrician to have him check the circuit breakers as they may have been weak. The electrician came and replaced both GFIC breakers. The repair cost was $147.66 with the service call and parts.
>
> The following week, my sister called and said the unit had quit working again. Again, the circuit breaker had tripped. I reset breaker and it worked again. She continued to use the unit, but kept telling me it would trip the breaker from time to time, but only when it was plugged into the bedroom outlets. When in the kitchen or bath area, it was ok. The bath and kitchen have 20 amp GFIC circuits. She also said it only happed when the power head was installed on hose. When she used the hose nozzles, it never happened.
>
> I brought my wife's vacuum cleaner over to them and I took hers to our house. The next day, my wife was using the new unit from my sister and it tripped the breaker. She had been using the unit for about 15 minutes and the hose and power head were installed when this occurred. I finally returned the unit to the store at Casa Grande for warranty repair.
>
> I called 888-391-8867 yesterday to inquire about the repair process and was informed that the service department had checked the unit out and there was no problem with the vacuum cleaner. THERE IS A PROBLEM WITH THIS UNIT! I don't know if it is the hose, the power head or what, but I will not be satisfied until the problem is corrected. The label on the unit states that the maximum draw is 12 amps and therefore, it should operate on a 15 amp circuit.
>
> Please get back to me with some answers. Thank you.
>
>
> [REDACTED]
>
Thank you for your time and consideration.

productDescription: Dehumidifier
incidentDescription:
My husband and I purchased a Dehumidifier from Lowe's on 3/19/2012 for $259.00 + Sales Tax.  The dehumidifier was a Soleus SG-DEH-70-2 / MD000121511000.  The unit ran for some time and then, while we were home, we smelled the unit burning.  We unplugged it and afterward, tried a few times to see if it would run.  It never did run again.  Due to problems locating a proper recycling/disposal facility, the unit stayed around our house.

Looking back on the incident, we should have notified you right away as it may have helped other people.

It was fortuitous that the unit never ran again and yet stayed around our house, as the recall was issued and we had to return the applicable parts for a refund.  We have just received our refund check for $202.50.  Although we are pleased to be refunded at least part of our costs, we are wondering why we were unable to submit our receipt and receive a refund of the purchase price.

There were a number of fortunate occurrences for our issue - our house, rescued animals, and 89 year old mother were harmed as a result of the dehumidifier's problems, we were home at the time of the problem, the unit stayed around due to our inability to find a proper facility, and we were able to receive almost 80% of our purchase price back.

We realize recalls are tough and thank you for your work on this issue.  If there is an option to submit our receipt, we will happily do so.

Thank you!

incidentDescription:

Approximately 2 weeks ago, I smelled a plastic burning odor emitting from the top of the heater while it was turned on. I turned off the unit for the evening after inspecting it.  The unit visually appeared to be ok.  On 03/20/2014, I turned the heater on a high level.  After approximately 45 minutes of being in use, I heard a fizzing noise, followed by a little pop with a spark emitting again from the top of the unit through the wire screen that protects the heating element.  Almost immediately, smoke started to come out from the unit in the area where the on/off switch is located.  I quickly unplugged the heater and removed it from the home as it continued to smoke. I have contacted Holmes to inform them of this product issue.  There have been multiple reports on the internet of this same issue occurring with this model heater.  Holmes has indicated to me that there currently is no active recall.  I feel that the chance for tragedy is extremely high with this unpredicatable unit.

Now we know why Target so kindly donated these units to Goodwill instead of destroying them. Thanks, Target.

incidentDescription:

About ten minutes elapsed since I had switched off the hair dryer when I heard a whooshing sound. At first I was uncertain where the sound was coming  from but quickly saw that it was the hair dryer. On March 3, 2014, I reported this incident by phone to [REDACTED], Conair Claims Manager at her office in Stamford

incidentDescription: The toaster caught on fire when the dial wasn't turned past the minimum point

productDescription: Crofton Model WJ-056 Electric Griddle
incidentDescription:
While using a Crofton Family Size Electrical Griddle Item # 9660-06, Model WJ-056 on the morning of March 1, 2014 the unit began to emit smoke smelling of electrical burning and the temperature probe end of the power cord became hot to the touch and started smoking. The unit was immediately unplugged and the smoke stopped and the temperature probe cooled down.

Examination of the unit revealed that the metal encased heating element that runs around the bottom of the unit was swollen and bulged at one point for about one inch of its length.

I have contacted the distributor of the unit, Wachsmuth & Krogmann Inc 1800 Nicholas Blvd Elk Grove Village, IL 1-888-367-7373, www.wk-usa.com  the same day via e-mail.

A few days later a representative of the company called me and asked if I would return the unit to them for inspection. They are sending me a shipping label.

Should I return the unit to them.

Please advise.

productDescription: Coffeemaker
manufacturer: Sunbeam Products, Inc. d/b/a  Jarden Consumer Solutions
brand: Mr Coffee Single Cup Brewing System
incidentDescription:
Consumer reported that she experienced the same incident of Release #12-263.  Hazard: A build-up of steam in the water reservoir can force the brewing chamber open and expel hot coffee grounds and water, posing a burn hazard.  

While using the coffee maker it had completed its cycle and she noticed that it opened up and expelled coffee all over the room which caught her on the side of her right face.  She received minor burns, no medical attention was needed.  Fortunately she was not closer to the unit.

2/2014 She went online and found out it was recalled, the manufacturer was contacted and the item returned as instructed.  She just wanted this incident to be added to the agency's database.
The product model number is affected by the recall.
victimSeverity: Injury, Level of care not known

incidentDescription:
I was blow drying my hair and it started shooting sparks followed by smoke out of the handle. 
( I am keeping the dryer for third party testing if need be ).
